messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

item: "tell doctor if symptoms do not improve within 7 days"
set: ["tell doctor if symptoms do not improve within 7 days", "tell your doctor if your symptoms do not improve", "call doctor if symptoms do not improve", "call doctor if symptoms do not improve after 6 weeks", "call your doctor if symptoms do not improve or if they get worse", "call your doctor if your hives do not improve after 3 days", "7 days", "tell doctor if symptoms flare", "use within 7 days before MAO inhibitor", "tell your doctor if these do not settle", "do not use within 14 days before MAO inhibitor use", "3 to 7 days", "may take 1 to 4 days before symptoms improve", "do not inject two doses within 3 days of each other", "do not double up if dose is not controlling symptoms", "do not take within 5 days before or 14 days after using an MAO inhibitor"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
